no_adcom_quote.quote: The Division did not refer this efficacy supplement to an advisory committee because darolutamide is not the first drug in this class, the safety profile is acceptable in this indication, and the clinical trial design is similar to that used previously in this class.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for NDA212099 (NUBEQA/darolutamide). The FDA Multi-discipline Review states the Division did not refer the application to an advisory committee because darolutamide is not the first drug in its class, its safety profile is acceptable in the indication, and the trial design mirrored prior drugs in the class. References to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee (ODAC) in the review concern earlier general FDA meetings about the metastasis-free survival (MFS) endpoint for nmCRPC, not a meeting held for this application.
